# AI Brand Visibility template — vendored design reference

This directory preserves the `app/` design system source from:

<https://github.com/LOOPAPPdev/ai-brand-visibility-template/tree/main/app>

The source was cloned for the LOOP Dynamics redesign. The runnable application remains the existing Vite/React Flow frontend in `frontend/`; the vendored Remix/React Router route modules are reference material and are not imported by the build.

Adapted patterns used by the default page:

- Cloudflare/Kumo light canvas and surface tokens.
- Dot-grid research workspace background.
- Rounded white cards with restrained ring/shadow elevation.
- Blue brand focus states, compact mono labels, and responsive asymmetric workspace layout.
- Explicit separation between primary evidence, hypotheses, and actions.

The original source is preserved for attribution and future design-system updates.
